refnamediv.refpurpose: Decodes data encoded with MIME base64

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.parameters;
string
The encoded data.
strict
If the strict parameter is set to &true; then the base64_decode function will return &false; if the input contains a character from outside the base64 alphabet, if any data follows the padding, if the final group is truncated to a single character, or if the amount of padding is invalid. Otherwise, invalid characters are silently discarded and none of these other conditions are checked.
